scientific.integrity: The primary open-problem text was materially inspected, including the statement, expected extremizer, and its dimension-three prior-coverage remark. Published and semantic searches covered parallel-plank, slab, partial-volume, centered-rearrangement, stability, and incomplete-beta formulations. The proof is analytic and all computations are diagnostic only.
limitations: The theorem assumes all planks are parallel; it does not solve the original problem for differently oriented planks.
The dimension-three inequality is already covered by a stronger unrestricted result explicitly cited in the primary source.
The sharp stability law is stated for the no-waste case in which the normal-coordinate union has measure equal to the total width.
Because the proof uses classical one-dimensional rearrangement, an equivalent unindexed observation in older literature remains a historical originality risk.

title: Sharp ball-volume profile for every parallel plank family
